_comment: Scene for the air region window (A10): strategicairview with its details panel. The default state is the window with Details closed, the capture 'details' the panel open. Values are the user's Western Poland of 2026-10-17 (the 30 days of Our fighters lost and Enemy fighters lost are drawn by the figures script, the renderer has no chart). Written by scratch/phases/A10/build/make_scene.py; keys are explained in wiki/Game-Recipes.md.

windows.name: strategicairview
windows._note: The window is centred and opens at its file position (712,300); the code does not place it (open in game, design item 7). Hidden in a 1936 peace: the weather pictures but one, the superiority 'disabled' bar, the crypto icon, the friendly-presence marks and every combat picture, count and damage list of air_combat_wnd (they show in a war).

setup._note: air map mode, the airbase row and its wings
drops the selection, the air map mode stays

an empty spot of the strategic region Eastern Germany between Berlin and Silesia in the Home view (about 1485,922: ESTIMATED from reference/mod/air_selection.jpg, not measured). The first launch measures it with Invoke-GameSteps -Region on a grid capture; a region that is not Eastern Germany does not matter. Raw position: it breaks when the map view changes.

captures.name: details
captures._note: Details open: the panel docks at the window's right.

manual: The chart with data, a war region (combat pictures, counts and damage lists over the sky piece), a region with friendly airbases (the marks beside the wing icons) and a region with a crypto-broken enemy are not in a 1936 peace; in a paused 1936 game every count is 0 and the chart is empty: the code hides max, average and the x labels without statistics.
Where the click on the region lands is an estimate (see the step's note): measure it on the first launch.
checklist: 1. Recipe: air map mode, Escape, a click on an empty spot of a region opens the window at x 712, y 300 (the whole view 580x718 with Details closed). Does it clear the air wing panel (ends at x 705) and the theatre boxes (y 140-250)? Note where the window really sits.

2. Title strip: the region name in hoi_30header at the left (a long name such as Labrador and Newfoundland ends before the Details button), the Details button at x 400 and the close button at x 546 of the window. Escape and the close button close it.

3. Sky card: the weather picture sits inside its frame, the Air Superiority caption over the 284 px bar; the bar fills green over red by the region's superiority; with no superiority the grey 'disabled' bar shows instead; the crypto icon (if shown) sits at the picture's lower left.

4. Forces card: the six rows read Our value | icon | caption | icon | Enemy value, values right and left aligned to the icons, hoi_20b; the detection and efficiency icons at 24 px; the head bar says Our and Enemy. Hover a value: the tooltip of the vanilla text box (AIR_SUPERIORITY_TYPE_n) shows. No grey pill plate behind the detection and efficiency values.

5. Mission card: Our Missions, the three category buttons and Enemy Missions sit in the head bar over the sky picture; clicking a category button and the Our / Enemy toggles works as before; the tooltip boxes over the sky still show their tooltips.

6. Click Details: the panel opens 6 px right of the window (x 1298), 914x718. Click Details again: does the panel close? Days / Months / Years: the chosen button shows frame 2, the chart and the labels change.

7. The chart: a 800x276 plot with a dark ground. Tick one channel (the tick box and the cell both): a 3 px line in the swatch's colour; the largest value touches the upper dotted line and its half the middle one (compare with max_value and avg_value). The right end of the line is today, the labels read 30 ... Days ... 0. Tick a second and a third channel (any number draws). Untick: the line goes.

8. The labels: max_value, avg_value and min_value stand on their grid lines, 100.0 and up are not cut. With nothing ticked, or every value 0, max and avg are hidden by the code; with no statistics the three x labels are hidden.

9. The channel table: twelve rows, a caption each (the mod's English text under every language), Our cell and Enemy cell with a tick box, a swatch in the line's colour and the VALUE ONLY, red for Our and green for Enemy. If a cell shows the old whole text (Our fighters lost: 136) or the bare key AIRVIEW_DETAILS_CHANNEL_n: the localisation file under replace did not win (fallback A in build.json).

10. A ticked cell lights up (frame 2, the pick band) beside its coloured box; an unticked cell is transparent and still takes the click (frame 1). Click the value of a cell: does it tick the channel like the tick box?
11. Scroll nothing: there are no lists. Every row of the table is banded on even rows. Read error.log for sprite lines naming GFX_1440p_AR_ or GFX_strategicair_linechart.
12. Both states: details closed (window alone) and details open (1500 px wide, y 300 to 1018). Does the whole view stay clear of the right edge, the theatre boxes and the bottom bar?
